integrity: The abstract homology group and torsion were previously implied by Ko–Park; the new claim is the equivariant splitting and exact section count.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to two unordered particles on the complete five-vertex graph; finite exact computation of equivariant section count; no higher-homology or general-graph claim; residual unindexed-literature overlap risk.
title: Two equivariant integral sections of the two-particle first-homology projection for the complete five-vertex graph
